com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Reject one invoice with an optional supported reason and review note. Check its current approval and accounting-export state before deciding. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview rejecting the selected invoice because its purchase order is missing, with the note: Supplier must provide the purchase order. Show its current approval and export state, then wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_reject_invoice, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare rejection of one invoice using an optional supported reason and note. Requires confirmation and approval capability.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
